title: Cartwise+ Membership Courtesy Rates for Members With a Clean Card Record
content:
A courtesy rate is applied to the settled share of a past-due Cartwise+ Membership period fee for members whose card has not failed before.

**Schedule.**

| Retry captures in the last twelve months | Fee charges captured on record | Courtesy rate |
|---|---|---|
| none | 24 or more | 0.9 |
| none | fewer than 24 | 0.95 |
| one or more | any | 1.0 |

## Definitions

- **Retry capture**: a fee charge of the renewal-retry type on the membership — a declined period fee captured on a later attempt.
- **Last twelve months**: whole months ending today; a capture dated on the same day of the month twelve months back is not counted.
- **Fee charges captured on record**: every fee charge on the membership over its whole history, of any fee type.
- The rate multiplies the settled part of the period fee.

## Hypothetical cases (settled part 9.99)

| Retry captures in window | Charges on record | Rate | Settled part at the rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 30 | 0.9 | 8.991 |
| 0 | 24 | 0.9 | 8.991 |
| 0 | 23 | 0.95 | 9.4905 |
| 1 | 30 | 1.0 | 9.99 |
